title: Recent setups
description: New Agent's recent setups (#2134), kept per device and hub, ids only (spec/fixtures/recents). The rules are in the fixtures; these are the shapes they read and write.

RecentSetup.description: One setup that started an Agent from New Agent: the ids its fields held, never a message. `launcher` and `model` are "" for the configured defaults; `mode` and `effort` are "" unless the agent is Claude Code.

machine.description: The client's machine key: the machine id, "group|id" for another group of hubs.

cwd.description: The folder picked (not the worktree a start made in it).

mode.description: Claude Code's permission mode; "" for the launcher's own and for every other agent.

effort.description: Claude Code's thinking effort; "" as for mode.
